description: Election Commission - Amended the Names of Secrecies and Political parties Extra Ordinary Gazette Number 2404/63 on Dated 04/10/2024.
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns amendments to the list of political party secretaries as decided by the Election Commission, under the Parliamentary Elections Act. It directly relates to the electoral process and the administration of political parties, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which includes "Electoral commission appointments and decisions."
